scenario: Ambient permissions boundary per LSCP.2.5.1 — rule RHSs must not `emit` or `retract` an `ambient` schema (the boundary keys on the `ambient` overlay modifier, so `scope logical ambient` is read-only too). The compiler must reject any such action; the diagnostic names the schema and points the author at emitting a request schema instead. Pin: an `emit Light ...` against a `scope logical ambient` `Light` rejects with DS_VALIDATE_AMBIENT_EMIT_FORBIDDEN.
rules_ds:
schema Light scope logical ambient:
    entity_id: String key
    state: String mutable

schema Switch scope logical:
    state: String key

rule force_light_on:
    Switch sw where sw.state == "pressed"
->
    emit Light entity_id: "kitchen" state: "on"
